title: Handoff Tunnel Sync: SE + ProServices weekly brief (2028-04-11)
content:
Date: 2028-04-11
Facilitator: Priya Desai
Duration: 45m
Attendees: Priya Desai (SE), Ethan Cole (ProServices), Marta Kovács (Solutions Eng), Liam O'Connor (Customer Success), Sofia Martinez (SRE liaison)
Purpose: Weekly checkpoint for active handoffs — surface customer risks, align on next technical milestones, and confirm ownership for any open tasks in the tunnel.

High-level status (TL;DR):
- 3 active handoffs in tunnel (Veridian Health, BlueScribe, Nimbus Retail).
- Veridian: on track for pilot, small latency regression observed in staging (prefetch/KV cache mismatch).
- BlueScribe: blocked by customer network ACL & certificate rotation; working with Private deployment engs.
- Nimbus: delayed rollout due to model change request (quantization + accuracy tradeoff); exploring staggered canary.

Agenda:
1) Quick wins / items closed this week
2) Customer deep dives (per-account notes)
3) Cross-team blockers and escalations
4) Action items and owners
5) Risks & next sync

1) Quick wins
- Completed SE -> ProServices handoff checklist for Veridian (runbook updated) — Marta completed smoke tests against 2.1.0 model variant.
- Canary routing policy for low-cost fallback added to staging for Nimbus (config PR merged: ops#312).
- New KB (internal) on KV cache priming patterns published (confluence link in artifacts).

2) Customer deep dives
A) Veridian Health (pilot target: 2028-04-22)
- Current status: pilot environment provisioned in Dedicated pool; initial traffic routed through dedicated-alias-veryd; observed 8–12% token latency regression for long-context (2k+ tokens) in staging vs baseline.
- Root cause hypothesis: mismatch in KV cache warm-up across multi-shard serving (prefetch not seeded for historical context).
- Temporary mitigation: enable aggressive prefix caching for pilot traffic (SRE to flip flag).
- Customer ask: confirm P95 latency < 220ms for typical 1k token chat flows before pilot kickoff.
- Open tickets: SE-5827 (investigate KV priming), INF-1092 (SRE toggle for prefix cache).
- Action items: Sofia to run KV priming A/B on staging and report delta (due 2028-04-13). Marta to produce a short runbook section with recommended warm-up traffic patterns for customer ops (due 2028-04-14).
- Risk: Medium — if priming fails we may need a temporary routing to higher-capacity nodes (cost impact).

B) BlueScribe (private deployment evaluation)
- Current status: Private control plane deployed in customer VPC; progress stalled by mutual TLS certificate rotation policy and customer firewall rules disallowing our health-check endpoints.
- Blocker details: customer rotated internal PKI last week; our agent's cert chain not yet trusted by their gateway. BlueScribe security requires cross-signed cert by 2028-04-15.
- Work in progress: ProServices (Ethan) coordinating with BlueScribe infra team; SRE providing minimal cert bundle for testing.
- Action items: Ethan to escalate customer PKI requirements to Legal/Security for contract addendum if needed (due 2028-04-12). Liam to schedule a joint jumper session with BlueScribe infra + our onboarding engineer 2028-04-13.
- Risk: High — legal timeline could slip; if unresolved, pilot launch delayed by 2+ weeks.

C) Nimbus Retail (staged canary)
- Current status: Nimbus requested a smaller model with FP16 quantization to reduce per-token cost; internal eval shows slight degradation on named-entity recall for receipts parsing dataset.
- Decision point: proceed with staggered canary vs hold for model retraining.
- Proposed approach: run a 10% canary on non-critical customer segment with parallel A/B evals (quality monitors enabled), hold main rollout until regression < 3% on NER.
- Action items: Marta to create canary config and test dataset split in Linear (due 2028-04-14). SE to enable quality monitors and tie regression alerts to alerting channel (due 2028-04-15).
- Risk: Low-to-Medium — cost savings vs QA tradeoff; need to ensure fallbacks to full-precision model are automated.

3) Cross-team blockers & escalations
- SRE capacity: next week maintenance window on dedicated pool will limit capacity by ~15% during weekday mornings. Impact: may affect Canary throughput for Nimbus and Veridian pilot traffic. Sofia to publish maintenance window in status channel and suggest rescheduling if it conflicts with pilot windows.
- Legal/Contract: BlueScribe PKI addendum may require security sign-off. Ethan to loop in security lead (Anya Park).
- Observability gap: token-level cost attribution for private deployments not surfaced in console; product asked for a short spec to add a per-route cost metric. Action: Priya to draft spec with examples (due 2028-04-18).

4) Actions (owner — due)
- Sofia Martinez — run KV priming A/B and publish results (2028-04-13)
- Marta Kovács — Veridian warm-up runbook section + Nimbus canary config (2028-04-14)
- Ethan Cole — escalate BlueScribe PKI to Legal/Security and coordinate jumper session (2028-04-12 for escalation, 2028-04-13 for session)
- Liam O'Connor — confirm customer ops attendees and send calendar invites for BlueScribe jumper (2028-04-12)
- Priya Desai — draft per-route cost metric spec for console (2028-04-18)
- SE Team — prepare automatic fallback policy for Nimbus canary (owner TBC) (2028-04-15)

5) Risks & contingency plans
- If KV priming does not close Veridian regression: fallback to higher-power node pool for first 2 pilot days; alternate is a short token-throttling shim on request ingress (prefer fallback).
- If BlueScribe PKI timeline slips: propose temporary hosted-proxy option (data plane tunnel through dedicated gateway) while contractual items finalize.
- If Nimbus canary shows >5% regression: abort canary and revert to full-precision model; notify customer and propose retrain timeline.

Parking lot / questions
- Need an internal checklist item for "confirm customer PKI rotation window" added to handoff runbook.
- Consider a small automation to seed KV cache from historical session snapshots for long-context customers.

Next sync: 2028-04-18 09:30 PT (30m)
Meeting notes owner: Priya Desai
Document history: initial draft 2028-04-05; updated with SRE priming results placeholder 2028-04-11.
